rows.note: Use this for the curved underside of the foot, rather than for an architectural arch.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 ge3 zuk1 gung1 hou2 tung3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an inverted-U shape and, in context, the corresponding stone arch structure.

example.english: This bridge has an arch shape, so it is quite sturdy.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kiu4 hai6 gung2 jing4 gei2 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Use this for an archway or an opening that people pass through.

example.english: There is an arch at the entrance.
example.jyutping: jap6 mun4 hau2 go2 dou6 jau5 dou6 gung2 mun4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a naturally formed arch-shaped opening in rock.

example.english: We did not see the natural arch until we reached halfway up the mountain.
example.traditional: 行到山腰先見到個天然拱門。
example.jyutping: haang4 dou3 saan1 jiu1 sin1 gin3 dou2 go3 tin1 jin4 gung2 mun4
